thread:
incident-bot: ALERT: gpu-queue: queued requests > 1200 for 3m; p95 latency > 3.2s; auto-fallback triggered to spot-pool-2 :warning:

sre-oncall: the alert just paged me, jumping in. any customer-facing impact yet?

Yun (ml-infra): seeing sustained queue growth on us-west2-gpu. autoscaler attempted scale but hits GCE quota + pool max. logs show repeated 'InsufficientCapacity' for preemptible GPUs.

Samir: confirmed. autoscaler metrics: min_nodes=4, max_nodes=50, current=50 and still queue rising. looks like preemptible pool was shrinking due to evictions earlier.

Olivia: timeline: 14:07 preempt churn started (multiple 1-2 min evictions), 14:09 autoscaler launched replacements but GCE returned capacity errors at 14:10. fallback pool (spot-pool-fallback) exhausted at 14:12.

Liz (infra): digging into instance events, GCE reports: 
```
{"error": "InsufficientCapacity", "zones_checked": ["us-west2-a","us-west2-b"], "requested_type": "A100-preemptible"}
```
We have a hard cap on on-demand pool creation for this project to avoid cost spikes.

Ged (support): customers reporting degraded response times via status page. we've started an incident banner: "Generation delays in US-WEST region; engineers investigating".

sre-oncall: immediate mitigations — list?
Yun (ml-infra): 1) route new requests to alternate region (us-east) for non-low-latency customers; 2) scale up on-demand fallback pool (requires infra approval); 3) temporarily lower model size for queued requests (quantized variant) to absorb tokens; 4) throttle low-priority internal jobs.

Samir: routing change command ready: 
```
# switch route policy for us-west2 -> prefer us-east fallback
curl -X POST https://console.redwood/api/routing/override -d '{"from":"us-west2","to":"us-east","priority":"best-effort"}' -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN"
```

Olivia: I'm handing off to Liz for infra ops to approve on-demand spin-up. sro: can you take the mobile/low-latency customer triage? @Rene please prepare comms.

Liz (infra): approving on-demand will require a quick quota bump and manual pool create. I'm on GCP console now. if we go this route, cost guardrails will be overridden for 30m. request ETA ~8-12m to reach healthy nodes if available.

deploy-bot: AUTO-CHANGE detected: routing-override request queued by Samir. change id: change-68243. needs 2 approvals to execute.

sre-oncall: @Liz please approve change-68243. meanwhile Samir, please prepare the smaller-model fallback plan and a rider to drop priority on internal eval jobs.

Samir: working on a dynamic model fallback. snippet for inference router: 
```
if queue_size > 600 and region == "us-west2": model = "gpt-small-quant" else model = "gpt-std"
```
Rolling this as config flag to router in 2m.

Yun (ml-infra): quick note: we can't fallback to the cached KV for all sessions; some chat sessions will see context trimmed. will include note in comms.

Ged (support): We should mark high-value customers to route to on-demand only. compiling list now.

Liz (infra): approved change-68243. creating on-demand pool now. creating node-pool on us-west2-b: 
```
gcloud container node-pools create on-demand-fallback --machine-type=a2-highgpu-1 --num-nodes=8 --region=us-west2
```

sre-oncall: heads-up: autoscaler logs show repetitive backoff due to reaching project-level GPU quota. if pool creation succeeds, we still might not hit desired node count.

Olivia: Samir, can we flip routing immediately for background/non-urgent requests? do it now if safe.

Samir: flip done. change id: routing-68244. Applied rules: background & internal -> us-east; external high-priority remains us-west.

incident-bot: NOTE: banner updated: "Partial degradation in US-WEST region reduced after routing adjustments; on-demand scaling in progress."

sre-oncall: real-time checks: queue dropped from 1.3k -> 580 after routing + model-fallback. p95 latency trending down from 3.2s -> 1.6s. still watching.

Liz (infra): on-demand pool creation returned success for 6/8 nodes healthy. two nodes stuck in provisioning due to image pull failures, investigating. I can manually retry those nodes.

Samir: thanks. keeping low-priority jobs throttled with a leaky-bucket limiter: 
```
POST /admin/throttle
{"tag":"internal-evals","rate":"5r/s"}
```

Rene (pm): drafting customer update: short note explaining regional preemptible interruptions and mitigation steps. Will post to status at EOD unless we need an earlier update.

Ged (support): high-priority customer A has been routed to us-east successfully; they confirmed lower latency with quick smoke test.

sre-oncall: next actions: 1) confirm remaining on-demand nodes healthy (Liz); 2) monitor queue/latency for 30m, revert routing when stable (Samir); 3) post post-mortem runbook items (Yun + Liz) around quota/reserve for peak days; 4) escalate to capacity planning to increase on-demand emergency pool (Rene).

Olivia: handing off to next on-call in 30m. leaving notes in PagerDuty incident.

incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: severity=sev2, impacted-region=us-west2, status=mitigated->partial, assign=sre-oncall, next-update ETA 15m.

sre-oncall: thanks all. I'll remain monitoring until stable. if queue starts rising again, escalate to exec.

(End of thread)
